unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI as a dimensionless index ranging from -1.0 to 1.0
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the single `NDVI` band directly; values are already physical and carry no scale factor. Each image composites every scene acquired in that calendar year, keeping the most recent valid pixel, so a year with sparse cloud-free coverage may be represented by observations from an unrepresentative season. Check per-year image availability over the area of interest before building trend series, and note that the annual step means within-year phenology is not recoverable.

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: Landsat Collection 2 Tier 1 Level 2 annual 30 m NDVI composites are admitted, as are annual 30 m NDVI series computed directly from Landsat Collection 2 surface reflectance; MODIS MOD13/MYD13 tiers, GIMMS, SPOT VEGETATION and PROBA-V vegetation indices are excluded.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy defines which product counts as the anchor, not whether a paper may also use other vegetation-index products. A study comparing sensors is admissible as long as an annual 30 m Landsat NDVI surface is itself operationally processed.

substituted_for.paper_used: Annual 30 m NDVI over 2001-2020 from the National Ecosystem Science Data Center of the Chinese National Science and Technology Infrastructure
substituted_for.reason: The Earth Engine catalog publishes no Chinese national NDVI collection. The NESDC 30 m annual product is distributed only through its own portal.
substituted_for.why_this_substitute: The Landsat Collection 2 annual NDVI composite matches the source on all three defining properties at once: 30 m pixel size, annual time step, and a record spanning 2001-2020. Both series are ultimately Landsat-derived at the same resolution, so the observable identity is preserved.

rejected_alternatives.MODIS/061/MOD13Q1: the former anchor: 250 m and 16-day, matching neither the resolution nor the annual step, and far too coarse for the 30 m terrain stratification the source performs
rejected_alternatives.NASA/GIMMS/3GV0: 9.3 km, three orders of magnitude coarser than the source grid
rejected_alternatives.LANDSAT/COMPOSITES/C02/T1_L2_32DAY_NDVI: 30 m but 32-day; the source works on annual values, so an annual composite is the closer construction
rejected_alternatives.LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2: surface reflectance rather than a published NDVI series, and Landsat 8 alone starts in 2013, so 2001-2012 would need separate Landsat 5 and 7 handling

substituted_for.residual_gap: The catalog composite takes the most recent valid pixel of each year, whereas the source product is a national annual NDVI dataset whose compositing rule is defined by its own producer. Annual values are therefore not numerically interchangeable, only comparable in resolution and time step.
